scenarios.description: Wired LAN,1080p60 desktop; same host/client/codec/audio/HDR params
Wi-Fi repeat runs; record channel/link quality and jitter, do not change system settings
Isolated lab network/device with authorized loss/RTT/bandwidth profile; record exact profile, no workstation NIC modification
Source-supported high-fps game at actual display/codec limits; record achieved rather than requested fps
Known HDR pattern/content, record metadata/output capability and SDR fallback
At least two independent changing displays, separate frame IDs and sync
Increase independent streams to negotiated encode/decode/VRAM/bandwidth limits; explain rejection
Physical output/input device unplug/replug under active session, capability changes
Host/client suspend+resume, reconnect and lease/instance/display persistence
Proposed 8-hour stability run after baseline capture; record failures/thermal/resource drift, not an approved SLO
Start A/B/C, control A, switch B, disconnect all, reconnect C; confirm apps/displays persist; explicitly stop B, A/C survive
Two authorized clients race lease; reject second controller and stale input; authorized read-only join independent of control

measurementContract.clockRequirement: Same-clock RTT/decode durations only. Cross-machine timestamp differences require documented calibration, uncertainty and capture date; glass-to-glass uses one camera/clock observing both physical displays.

collection.overlay-estimate: Record reference client overlay statistics with capture time; estimate only, preserve definition and update period.
collection.decode-duration: Instrument decoder submit-to-output on one monotonic clock; record actual hardware/software path and frame IDs.
collection.network-rtt: One endpoint monotonic send/echo timing; preserve probe cadence and loss.
collection.glass-to-glass: High-speed camera sees host+client physical event/display together; count frames, record camera fps/exposure and resolution ±1 frame or measured uncertainty.
collection.frame-drop: Count missing/dropped frame IDs against expected frames over recorded window; preserve denominator.
collection.jitter: Record inter-arrival variation on one receiving monotonic clock with exact definition/interval.
collection.cpu: OS process CPU sampled every second; record normalization to whole machine vs one core.
collection.gpu: GPU engine utilization counter per process/adapter and cadence; absence unavailable.
collection.vram: Per-process/adapter dedicated allocation counter in MiB; shared memory separate.
collection.power: External wattmeter preferred, record host/client/system boundary and calibrated accuracy; driver estimate explicitly identified.
